cause_quote: The original Storage settings page added `new PollController(this, 2_000, …, false)` and called `this.maintenancePoll.start()` when maintenance was running, scheduling status reads regardless of tab visibility.
user_saw: The Storage settings tab kept making unnecessary Gateway status requests in the background while maintenance was running.
summary: Storage settings now pause automatic maintenance polling while the tab is hidden and refresh once when it becomes visible again.
reasoning: The feature's introducing diff starts a two-second poll during maintenance, and the controller at that commit invokes its callback without checking tab visibility. Immediately before the Solid migration, Storage settings still used the controller's default `always` mode, so the migration carried forward the background polling behavior.
